dev_43.query: SELECT name, date FROM races WHERE year = 1999 ORDER BY round DESC LIMIT 1

dev_62.query: SELECT T2.name FROM constructorStandings AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 on T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId ORDER BY T1.points DESC LIMIT 1

dev_5.query: SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

dev_13.query: SELECT AVG(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.forename = 'Eddie' AND T1.surname = 'Irvine' AND T3.year = 2000

dev_35.query: SELECT T3.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

dev_72.query: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Blue Beetle II'

dev_10.query: SELECT ( SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Emil Blonsky' ) - ( SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Charles Chandler' ) AS CALCULATE

dev_68.query: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Helen Parr'

dev_31.query: SELECT T2.Location FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

dev_35_count_audit.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_rows, SUM(attribute_value=(SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)) AS max_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN attribute_value=(SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute) THEN hero_id END) AS max_heroes FROM hero_attribute
